module.title: Days 1–10 | Competition Mastery Module
module.description: Production candidate: authored topic-driven International Knowledge Challenge curriculum.

lessons.title: World geography
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of world geography and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: International knowledge connects geography, history, science, culture, institutions, economics and technology. Use location, chronology and institutional roles to anchor recall. Similar names can describe different countries, organisations or historical periods, so read every qualifier. Global questions may contain culturally specific terminology; interpret it in context and avoid assuming that one country's convention applies everywhere. In this lesson, focus specifically on world geography. Identify the defining concepts, the distinctions that commonly cause mistakes, and the evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer. Practise moving from recognition to application: first identify what the question is testing, then select a method, perform the reasoning carefully, and verify the result against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log that records the misconception or decision error, not just the correct answer.
examples: A International Knowledge Challenge question on world geography should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking the option against all stated conditions.
Create a new world geography scenario with one tempting distractor. Explain why the correct response is supported and why the distractor fails.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused International Knowledge Challenge activity on world geography. Build a small table, diagram, worked example, speaking sample, writing sample or practice set as appropriate to the subject, then explain the reasoning behind the result.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on world geography: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third. Ask the learner to identify the exact clue, rule or evidence used before confirming the answer.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on world geography without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item International Knowledge Challenge checkpoint focused on world geography. Target at least six correct and justify every uncertain response.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished International Knowledge Challenge task demonstrating world geography and record the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach the learner toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction, and turn each error into a reusable rule or practice target. This lesson remains suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving world geography in the next practice session.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
